issue.title: Add the Successor Link glossary term
issue.description: Proposed by all bob-cli-5w phases: .1 note 3, .2 note 3, .3 note 2, .4 note 2, .5 note 2, .6 note 2, .7 note 2, .8 note 2, .9 note 2, .10 note 2, .11 note 2. Auto-decision glossary_term=no was not a human rejection. Distinct from the decision record; no memory edited. Small: one term and explicit cross-links, no new architecture.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Define Successor Link as the plain Task Link inserted for a newly unblocked direct dependent after a planned predecessor closes, placed after its predecessor or in its same-name continuation, promoting Ready/Blocked to Next. Link to glossary:task-link and glossary:task-dependency-link and docs/task-dependencies.md section 12. Require authorization and use the memory web conventions.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-5w phases all proposed this glossary change after the automatic glossary_term=no decision; consolidate it without editing memory.

payload.entry: INTEGRATION (bob-cli-7c land agent): bob-cli-7c added glossary:successor-offer (19075ee). The proposed Successor Link definition is now stale. A successor link is inserted only for a picked Successor Offer, not automatically after every planned close. Picked offers include direct dependents, residents of a recovered project, and project-finished ^prj pull-ins, and land at the §12.3 anchor or the implicit destination. If this term is still wanted, define it as the Task Link written for a picked offer and link [[glossary:successor-offer]] and [[decisions:unblocked-tasks-are-offered]].

payload.description: Check whether this pre-Successor-Offers task conflicts with or is superseded by bob-cli-7c

payload.entry: 2026-10-21 backlog audit: read the complete proposals and integration notes, decisions:unblocked-tasks-are-offered, and glossary:successor-offer. The accepted record (19075ee; epic bob-cli-7c) covers direct hand-offs, recovered-project residents, and project_finished pull-ins, requires an explicit pick, and records recovery/#hide behavior. These proposals describe automatic links or add terminology for that retired behavior. Their current policy and glossary needs are covered by the accepted offer records; closing as superseded without creating redundant historical memory.

payload.close_reason: Automatic successor-link policy was replaced by explicit Successor Offers
